market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Senator Susan Collins is a strong candidate who won in 2020 despite Democratic headwinds. If she runs (likely given no retirement signal), she is favored to hold the seat. Even accounting for a possible retirement and midterm penalty, Republican chances are significantly above 22.5%. The market appears to heavily undervalue a proven ticket-splitter in a slightly blue-leaning state.
evidence_points: Susan Collins won re-election in 2020 with 51 % of the vote despite Biden carrying Maine.
Maine’s Class 2 seat is held by Republicans; Collins has held it since 1997 and has survived multiple tough races.
The 2026 midterm may be challenging for the president’s party, but Collins’ independent brand and track record of ticket-splitting insulate her better than other Republicans.
